response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills, staff-level titles, and recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling at re:cinq. However, he falls well short of the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions — his GenAI experience appears to span roughly one year — and the resume shows no evidence of Python depth, RAG architectures, vector databases, or ML data pipelines. His breadth, mentoring track record, and MCP work make him worth a conversation, but he is not an obvious fit for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI role.
strengths: Recent hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow infrastructure experience at re:cinq
15+ years of production engineering across web, backend, embedded, and high-throughput systems
Proven mentorship and knowledge-sharing (workshops, courses, conference talks, open source)
concerns: Only ~1 year of GenAI/AI-agent experience versus the required 8+ years of AI-driven solutions
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience
Python is absent from his skills; cloud experience (AWS CDK) appears limited relative to the role's cloud-architecture demands

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG/vector DB and Python expertise
